# Contributor Licence Agreement

Version 1, 7 October 2026.

## Why this exists

commitwork is to be published under AGPL-3.0-or-later and also offered under PolyForm Internal Use
1.0.0, by written agreement, to those who cannot take it under the AGPL. The files
`manifests/wire-layer.json` lists are carved out under Apache-2.0 whichever of the two applies (the
repository's LICENSING.md). Offering both requires that one party hold the rights to license the
whole work under either. Today Portll wrote all of commitwork's own code, so it does. The first
outside contribution accepted without an agreement permanently removes that ability, because a
contribution's copyright stays with its author unless they grant otherwise.

This agreement is that grant. It is a **licence, not an assignment**: you keep the copyright in
everything you write, and you keep every right to use your own work however you wish.

Section 8 is the part that protects you. Portll commits that every accepted contribution stays
available under AGPL-3.0-or-later permanently, so this agreement cannot be used to take the open
version away.

## Definitions

**"You"** means the individual or legal entity agreeing to these terms. For a legal entity, an
entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that entity is treated as
a single contributor.

**"Portll"** means **John Hancock, trading as Portll**, an unincorporated business, and, from the
date of its incorporation, any company incorporated to carry on that business under the name
Portll or a name substantially similar. Section 9 governs how this agreement passes to that
company.

**"Contribution"** means any work of authorship, including any modification of or addition to an
existing work, that is intentionally submitted by You to Portll for inclusion in commitwork.
"Submitted" means any form of electronic or written communication sent to Portll or its
representatives, including a pull request, patch, issue attachment or mailing-list message, but
excluding communication conspicuously marked "Not a Contribution".

## 8. Portll's commitments to You

In consideration of the grants above, Portll agrees that:

a. Every Contribution accepted into commitwork will be distributed under AGPL-3.0-or-later, or a

These commitments bind any person or company to whom this agreement passes under section 9.

## 9. Incorporation and assignment

Portll is presently an unincorporated business carried on by John Hancock. You agree that Portll
may assign or novate this agreement, together with the rights granted under sections 1, 2 and 3,
to a company incorporated to carry on the Portll business, without needing Your further consent at
that time. This consent is given now so that incorporating does not require every contributor to
be found and asked again.

An assignment under this section takes effect only if the company assumes Portll's obligations
under section 8 in full. Portll may not otherwise assign this agreement without Your consent,
which You will not unreasonably withhold.

## 10. Moral rights

You retain Your moral rights. To the extent permitted by Part IX of the *Copyright Act 1968*

a. reproducing, adapting, modifying, combining and distributing it as part of commitwork;
b. distributing it without attributing You in the work itself, on the understanding that Your
   authorship is recorded in the project's version history under section 8(d);
c. making changes to it, including changes to correct defects, to follow the project's conventions
   or to adapt it to later versions of commitwork.

This consent is given genuinely and without duress or false pretence. It does not extend to
treatment of Your Contribution that would falsely attribute its authorship to another person.

## 11. Miscellaneous

This agreement is governed by the laws of South Australia, Australia. The parties submit to the

It is the entire agreement between You and Portll concerning Contributions, and supersedes any
prior understanding on that subject. If any provision is held unenforceable, the remainder stays
in force.

## Agreeing

Sign by whichever route the project's `CONTRIBUTING.md` describes, currently:

**Individuals** — on Your first pull request, CLA assistant posts a link. Follow it, sign in with
GitHub, give Your name and email address, and agree.

**Entities** — an authorised signatory should email **john@portll.net** stating that the entity
agrees to this agreement, and naming the individuals authorised to contribute on its behalf.

Agreement is recorded against this version of the text and covers all of Your later
Contributions. If the text changes, You will be asked to agree to the new version before Your next
Contribution is merged.
